author: STEYN2G
body:
First off I wanna say, that as a generally new player this section was hard to find and there shoukd be a new section just named "Suggestions".

My actual suggestion is implementing some kind of permanent rewards on the profile page or for that matter somewhere else. Here are some Ideas.

1. Basicly we could have a section on the top of the website under competitive named something original similar to Tournament winners/awards/trophies where there is a list of teams or players per tournament that have won first, second or third place as memorial or trophies.

2. Ocn has something called a Trophy case on a player profile which I thought we should have aswell, but if its too much of a ripoff i thought you could use these ideas,

- Making Stars/Icons of the tournament next to a players name on his profile to award a trophy for winning a tournament or achieving something else. When you scroll over this it should say which TM and which place, but every tournament place (1st to 3rd) would have its own color star.

-There is this background on your profile page behind your profile picture/mc face which you could use a Tournament winner background and just put literally pictures or icons of different trophies in the background with the tournament and tournament place written on it on the bottem like on a real trophy.

Would be cool if you guys could give some feedback on this, just some ideas I came up with.

Anyway,
I'd like to see permanent rewards in the future one way or the other.
